findings.summary: The page never says what retirement age is, so a 61-year-old can't tell whether the 3-year or the 6-year rule applies, or when they can withdraw without tax.
The legend '123 מקור · 123 מחושב · מונח' and codes like KH-19 and PF-18 are confusing and look like part numbers.
The 'חוקים וכללים · N' badges are unexplained ('ten what?') and make the reader nervous.
The investment track buttons (general, index-linked bonds, S&P 500) aren't explained, so the reader can't tell which is safer at their age.
The 12 small yearly bars have no shekel amounts and no colour key, so the gain from year 5 to year 6 can't be judged.
The 'נשאר בידיים' bar in the big chart has no number, so the reader had to look for it in the text, and 'אחרי דמי ניהול' wasn't understood.
Two tax figures seem to conflict: 47% in the warning box and 'at least 31%' in the list. The reader can't tell which one applies.
'From age 60 the tax brackets start lower' doesn't say how much lower.
The worked example covers only 5 years (taxed). There's no 6-year (tax-free) figure, though that's the option the reader would actually pick.
Missing information: whether the employer's share is kept if the reader leaves or retires before 6 years, and whether and how to file for the tax refund.
